verdict.rationale: ReadMe's own docs say developers can explore the API, make test calls from the documentation, and see real responses without writing code. Uploaded OpenAPI files become interactive documentation, and users' API keys can be injected into the hub. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the try-it console works, and clear documentation of generated multi-language code snippets (the "Pick a language" item is ambiguous).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: developers can explore your API, make test calls right from the documentation, and see real responses without writing a single line of code
ReadMe makes it simple to transform your existing OAS file into beautiful, interactive documentation that your developers will actually enjoy using.
Inject your users' API keys, server variables, and more!
